brief: Written late, after the open. October CPI came in hot (headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% vs ~0.2% expected), sending the 10-yr yield up roughly 5-7 bp toward 4.93%, and Fed Governor Waller said a 50 bp December hike should be considered if core ran at 0.3% or higher. Nasdaq 100 futures slid about 1.2% before the open, the dollar is firmer and VIX is up near 20.7. The 1:00 pm 10-year note auction is the main session risk for yields; CoreWeave reports after the close.
